items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: We played a one-nighter in Baltimore, Maryland. Bird was straight. And also a broadcast up there in Savoy Ballroom and he played Cherokee.

ctx.x: Bird was the same person when he played that big band. If anything, he lost after he got so far out. If I were -- here's what I mean. Bird was at his peak, he did his peak stuff -- I'll never forget. We played a one-nighter in Baltimore, Maryland. Bird was straight. And also a broadcast up there in Savoy Ballroom and he played

"Cherokee". The man, I think, must -- at the radio station must have been a musician because he said, "No, let's don't stop it. Just keep going." And we did. We kept it going right on through the night, you know what I mean?
